Name: a2a

Name: builtin

Name: override
Doc: Package override implements a three-layer config override cascade with per-field merge semantics: base → project → session.

Name: reflexes

Name: agentvalidation
Doc: Package agentvalidation provides config validation for agent profiles.

Name: agentworkflow
Doc: Package agentworkflow defines the adapter interfaces for the Agent Workflows pillar (see docs/architecture/agent-workflows-design.md): WorkflowEngine (deterministic sequencing) and StepExecutor (trustworthy, harness-backed execution of every unit of work an engine sequences).

Name: api
Doc: This file implements TASKS/scheduling/09-operator-http-api.md: /api/schedules, the operator/UI-driven CRUD surface for agent_schedules rows, plus a coarse liveness endpoint over the go-scheduler engine's own Status().

Name: assets
Doc: Package assets bundles the Nanite agent framework content (roles, skills, commands, docs, templates, vendor files, VERSION) into the Nanite binary via go:embed and exposes accessors used by the install pipeline.

Name: background
Doc: Package background — PTY backend.

Name: brand
Doc: Package brand is the single source of truth for application identity.

Name: chat
Doc: Package chat — universal rules content source.

Name: classify

Name: installcmd
Doc: Package installcmd implements the framework-injection flow shared by the `nanite-agent init` entry point and the legacy `nanite install` deprecation shim.

Name: config
Doc: Package config loads and merges nanite configuration from user-level (XDG: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nanite/config.yaml, default ~/.config/nanite/config.yaml) and project-level (./nanite.yaml).

Name: context
Doc: Package context defines the named slot substrate the Context Broker assembles into each dispatched LLM turn: slot identities, ordering (`SlotOrder`), default budgets, default compactability, and the `ContextWindow` that holds the per-turn slot store.

Name: contextbroker
Doc: Package contextbroker — assembly decider.

Name: describer
Doc: Package describer carries the per-call description-render contract (CW-20260512-0105 / SP-20260512-0008 W1B) for the Tool Broker.

Name: dispatch
Doc: Package dispatch implements the load-bearing seam between the Chat agent (harness) and Worker/Planner agents — the executeTask primitive.

Name: dispatcher
Doc: Package dispatcher is the single agent-flavored dispatch door.

Name: effort
Doc: Package effort defines the F1 Effort scalar — a single dial that biases (a) the token budget allocator and (b) reasoning-block enablement.

Name: elicitation
Doc: Package elicitation implements MCP elicitation/create support (spec 2025-06-18).

Name: envelope_render
Doc: Package envelope_render is the B3 pilot executor (CW-20260429-0032).

Name: filter
Doc: Package filter provides configurable output filters that transform LLM responses before they are displayed to the user or persisted.

Name: fsutil
Doc: Package fsutil provides crash-safe filesystem primitives.

Name: grounding
Doc: Package grounding implements memory-as-grounding (CW-20260419-0028, Phase 5 / E2).

Name: inspector
Doc: Package inspector provides the I1 per-turn event aggregator for the developer-mode context inspector (CW-20260426-0004, Phase 8).

Name: learnings
Doc: Package learnings is Layer 4 of the self-healing-tool-surface lens (CW-20260429-0009, D1).

Name: lifecycle
Doc: Package lifecycle provides a tracked-goroutine Manager with deterministic shutdown semantics.

Name: anthropic
Doc: Package anthropic is nanite's wrapper around the official anthropic-sdk-go for chat completions.

Name: openai
Doc: Package openai is nanite's SDK-backed wrapper around openai-go.

Name: loopdetect
Doc: Package loopdetect implements fingerprint-based tool-call loop detection (I2, CW-20260420-0029, Phase 8).

Name: mcp
Doc: Package mcp — dev_tools artifact resolver adapter.

Name: mcpconfig
Doc: Package mcpconfig provides import/export of MCP server configurations in the Claude Code .mcp.json format.

Name: memory
Doc: Package memory provides persistent memory storage, recall, and extraction backed by an embedded Tesseract memory store.

Name: messaging
Doc: Package messaging — caller.go

Name: otel
Doc: Package otel wraps the external feotel library, honoring NANITE_OTEL_DISABLED=1 and Config.Disabled to skip exporter init.

Name: pathsafe
Doc: Package pathsafe provides bounded path resolution that prevents traversal outside a caller-specified root directory.

Name: permission
Doc: Package permission — derivation.go implements parent → subagent permission RuleSet derivation (CW-20260512-0119, SP-20260512-0010 Wave 3).

Name: allplugins
Doc: Package allplugins imports all built-in plugin packages for their init() side effects, which register constructors in the plugin registry.

Name: adapterclaude
Doc: Package adapterclaude implements the Claude Code adapter plugin.

Name: adaptercodex
Doc: Package adaptercodex implements the Codex/Copilot CLI adapter plugin.

Name: adaptergemini
Doc: Package adaptergemini implements the Gemini CLI adapter plugin.

Name: nanitenative
Doc: Package nanitenative implements the nanite-native adapter plugin.

Name: adapteropencode
Doc: Package adapteropencode implements the Opencode CLI adapter plugin.

Name: cardrulesdemo
Doc: Package card_rules_demo is the reference plugin for the J5 card_rules manifest extension (CW-20260421-0013).

Name: catalog
Doc: Package catalog holds the embedded trust roots and parsing helpers for the nanite plugin catalog.

Name: devmode
Doc: Package devmode exposes a single compile-time constant, HostDevSigningBypass, that signing-enforcement call sites in internal/plugin, internal/plugin/catalog, and internal/plugin/install consult before deciding whether a missing or invalid signature is fatal.

Name: install
Doc: Package install validates plugin archives and their manifests before they are loaded into the host.

Name: scaffold
Doc: Package scaffold generates new Nanite plugin skeletons for the `nanite plugin new` command.

Name: providercatalog
Doc: Package providercatalog records the human-readable catalog metadata that pairs with each provider registered in the engine provider.Registry.

Name: recover
Doc: Package recover implements the recoverable-error taxonomy described by the self-healing-tool-surface lens (decisions.nanite.architecture.self_healing_tool_surface_lens — layer 3).

Name: recovery
Doc: Package recovery is the namespace root for Nanite's four recovery mechanisms — genuinely distinct answers to "what went wrong", grouped under one prefix rather than consolidated:

Name: broker
Doc: Package broker is the in-process subagent recovery broker for nanite's CLI/PTY agent sessions.

Name: orphansweep
Doc: Package orphansweep is the Orphan/Runtime Reaper — one of the four recovery mechanisms grouped under internal/recovery/*.

Name: pack
Doc: Package pack is the Recovery Pack — one of the four recovery mechanisms grouped under internal/recovery/*.

Name: reminders
Doc: Package reminders implements the deterministic trigger engine for agent-set reminders (J11, CW-20260426-0009).

Name: agent
Doc: Package agent is nanite's single agent-spawn entry point.

Name: safego
Doc: Package safego provides panic-safe goroutine and call wrappers.

Name: scheduler
Doc: This file (retrying_runner.go) implements the retry/backoff/on_fail policy layer TASKS/scheduling/04-retry-backoff-on-fail-policy.md and docs/engineering/architecture/12-scheduling.md's "Retry, backoff, and on_fail policy" section describe: go-scheduler itself only offers "retry the same firing every second, forever, uncounted" (confirmed directly by reading libs/go-scheduler/engine.go's tick() -- a failed Enqueue rolls agent_schedules.next_run back to the pre-claim value via SetScheduleNextRun, so the same firing becomes due again on the very next 1-second tick, with no cap and no backoff), so real retry/backoff/ failure policy has to live entirely in this Runner-decorator layer.

Name: secrets
Doc: Package secrets provides OS keychain-backed credential storage.

Name: reactions
Doc: Package reactions implements the harness-reactive self-tools reaction engine described in docs/engineering/architecture/ 11-harness-reactive-self-tools.md ("Where it lives" and "The import-cycle constraint, and what it means for each reaction kind" sections) and decided by TASKS/reflex-taxonomy/ 07-harness-reactive-self-tools-design-session.md (decisions 4-6).

Name: service
Doc: Package service — Dispatcher runner adapter.

Name: install
Doc: internal/service/install/adopt.go

Name: shell
Doc: Package shell provides user-facing shell command execution for the chat interface.

Name: skillvendor
Doc: Package skillvendor is the content-addressed vendored store for authored skill packages (SKILL.md + optional scripts/, references/, assets/ subdirectories).

Name: slogx
Doc: Package slogx installs a structured log/slog handler at startup and wraps it with a PII-aware redactor.

Name: seedcatalog
Doc: Package seedcatalog is the compile-time source of provider/model seed defaults — the values shipped with the binary, used to populate the providers/models tables on first install and as the absolute routing floor for code that cannot ask the DB.

Name: subagent
Doc: Package subagent implements nanite's inline subagent spawn flow — the control path by which a primary chat agent creates and supervises a short-lived secondary agent to handle a subtask (dogfood case: primary spawns one secondary to hit Engine MCP for a project summary, another to run a knowledge task).

Name: tool
Doc: Package tool defines the canonical tool interface for Nanite.

Name: intent
Doc: Package intent decides whether the current user turn needs tools, and if so which categories to hydrate into the Tools slot.

Name: stash
Doc: Package stash caches full tool definitions per session so the Tools slot can hold a compact pointer-summary by default and hydrate full defs only when intent is detected.

Name: workflowrunner
Doc: Package workflowrunner spawns a one-shot external workflow-runner subprocess (a Python LangGraph/CrewAI process, or a minimal test script standing in for one) that calls back into Nanite's harness via the workflow_execute_llm_step / workflow_execute_tool_step / workflow_verify_step MCP tools (CW-20260813-0011, design doc "How external engines integrate").

Name: workspace
Doc: Package workspace implements the AGENTS.md walk-up that populates SlotWorkspace from a session's working_dir (CW-20260512-0116, SP-20260512-0009 W6).

Name: models
Doc: Package models is the canonical in-memory registry of model metadata — provider binding, context window, max output tokens, pricing, and per-model capability flags.

Name: plugin
Doc: Package plugin exposes Nanite's host-specific extensions to the universal plugin contract defined in github.com/hollis-labs/plugin-sdk.
